privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL is https://crawler-test.com/. Note that many pages on this site, including the root domain, do NOT have Open Graph tags. A valid URL that DOES have OG tags for verification is https://crawler-test.com/social_tags/open_graph_tags. The agent must export to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/social_tags_export.csv' and create a report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/missing_social_tags.txt'. The report must contain: total URLs crawled, number of URLs missing OG tags, and 3 specific URLs missing them.
